## AI use

I used Claude Opus & Sonnet 5.5 for the following tasks: brainstorming and acting as a rubber duck, deep research, coding.

In particular,
brainstorming ways to polish the research question, questioning the validity of the models I was considering and using, searching for alternative approaches, finding literature to corroborate our thinking, and looking for data I can use.

In code, I asked it to code boring sections for me (such as extracting data from sources), translate it, help me plot, and find existing libraries/functions I can use. I also asked it to better structure/modularize my code, clean it up, and document my functions.

I also have GitHub Co-pilot line completion installed in VScode, where I developed this project.
